apps.name: Virtual Wardrobe
apps.subtitle: Private virtual try-on wardrobe
apps.localizedDescription: Build a personalized 3D avatar from a guided body scan and try on digital clothing. Privacy-first: adults-only consent, private storage, no face recognition, one-tap delete. Avatar generation is a clearly-labeled mock in this build.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial sideload build: magic-link auth, guided body capture, avatar, wardrobe, privacy controls.
